newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks ends higher on last 1996 trading day.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks ends higher on last 1996 trading day.

text.p: The Taiwan stock index ended slightly higher on Tuesday on last-minute buying from trust funds and brokers said the higher ending on the last trading day of 1996 should help sentiment after the market reopens.
Share prices weakened in late trade after initial gains but last-minute buying pulled the index to end 7.67 points or 0.11 percent up at 6,933.94. Turnover was a moderate T$44.8 billion.
Brokers noted apparant year-end window-dressing by trust funds for better performance though overall sentiment was quiet ahead of a three-day new year holiday.
